items.source: The description of the collection resource.
Flag indicating whether this resource is exported at all.
items.translation: 指示该资源是否被导出。

items.source: The path segment under which this resource is to be exported.
items.translation: 此资源要导出其下的路径段。

items.source: The rel value to use when generating links to this resource.
items.translation: 生成指向此资源的链接时应使用的 rel 值。

items.source: As of Spring Data REST 2.0, prefer using RepositoryRestResource to also be able to customize the relation type and description for the item resources exposed by the repository.
items.translation: 自 Spring Data REST 2.0 起，建议使用 RepositoryRestResource，以便能够自定义仓库所暴露的项目资源的关联类型和描述。
乔恩·布里斯宾，奥利弗·吉尔克

items.source: true if the resource is to be exported, false otherwise.
items.translation: 如果资源需要导出则为 true，否则为 false。

items.source: Annotate a Repository with this to influence how it is exported and what the value of the rel attribute will be in links.
items.translation: 使用此注解标注一个 Repository，以影响其导出方式以及链接中 rel 属性的值。
